Train 8 follow-up (a) from the train 5 Opus reviews; a merge-gate security fix. Current tools/merge-guard.mjs releaseReviewGate accepts a local review record if the run state has ANY completed claude/opus job with the record's jobId; it never checks that job is a review job or that the record's manifest really names it. Bind the record to its run manifest.

Required behavior in releaseReviewGate, after the existing state checks pass:
1. Require record.manifest to be exactly `.swarm/runs/${runId}/manifest.json` (string, no traversal, same directory as the record). Fail closed as 'review-run-state-mismatch' otherwise.
2. Read and JSON.parse that manifest; any read/parse error fails closed as 'review-run-state-mismatch'.
3. Find the job in manifest.jobs with id === record.jobId. Require it is a review job: either job.type === 'review' or job.resultFile === resultFile (release-train review manifests declare resultFile; never accept a job that declares neither).
4. Require job.resultFile === resultFile AND Array.isArray(job.outputs) && job.outputs.length === 1 && job.outputs[0] === resultFile. A job that merely lists the output path among other outputs, or any completed Opus job, must not attest.
5. Require job.agent === record.agent and (job.model === record.model || job.actualModel === record.model when job.model is absent) -- still keep the existing state.json binding.
Do not change non-release PR behavior, the metadata-only commit check, the head check, the result hash check or the verdict check. Keep all refusals non-secret (no paths from outside the run directory, no contents).

Tests: extend tests/merge-guard.test.mjs releaseFixture so each run directory also writes `.swarm/runs/<id>/manifest.json` (default: one job {id:'review', agent:'claude', model:'claude-opus-4-6', resultFile: RESULT_PATH, outputs:[RESULT_PATH]}, overridable). Add refusal cases: missing manifest, malformed manifest, job missing, manifest job id different, manifest job not a review (no type and no resultFile), manifest resultFile mismatch, outputs missing the result file, extra outputs, manifest path traversal / another run path. Keep every existing test green, including both job-array and job-map states.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/merge-guard.test.mjs tests/review-record.test.mjs -> all pass.

1) roundSpawnSpec does JSON.parse(STRESS_TEST_COMMAND) unguarded, so a malformed value rejects runRound with a raw stack. Catch it, print one clear line to stderr (e.g. 'test:stress: STRESS_TEST_COMMAND must be a non-empty JSON array of strings'), and exit 2 without spawning. Also reject a non-array, an empty array, or a non-string/empty argv[0].
2) onRunnerSignal kills the current round's process group and then process.exit()s immediately. Make it wait for the round child to exit (bounded fallback of 2 seconds if the child never emits exit) after killRoundProcessGroup, then exit 130 for SIGINT / 143 for SIGTERM. Keep the existing log line exactly: `stress round N/M: interrupted by SIG; killed the round process group`. Keep the no-child fast exit. Do not hang the event loop.
3) Add tests to tests/stress-interrupt.test.mjs: malformed STRESS_TEST_COMMAND exits non-zero with the clear message and spawns no round child; the existing SIGINT/SIGTERM cases still pass (exit code, log, group dead). Keep the existing passing 1-round stress case.
